purpose: Display comparable structured records with native table, sort, selection, state, density, visibility, and sticky column support.
avoidWhen: content-first browse cards or one record summary
accessibility: Use a semantic table with a native caption and stable row and column context.
Sortable headers expose aria-sort and selection controls use readable row labels when supplied.
Loading, empty, and error content remains available to assistive technology.
responsive: Reflows within constrained containers without changing the content contract.
Supports a stacked record presentation on narrow screens when row comparison needs more room than a horizontal table.
Retains shared control geometry and touch-target minimums.
motion: Uses shared duration and easing variables for state transitions.

api.name: columns
api.description: Column definitions used to render structured data.

api.name: rows
api.description: Structured rows rendered by the contract.

api.name: rowKey
api.description: Returns the stable key for each data row.

api.name: rowLabel
api.description: Configures row label for Data Table.

api.name: columnVisibility
api.description: Configures column visibility for Data Table.

api.name: selectionMode
api.description: Makes row selection cardinality explicit while preserving selectable compatibility.

api.name: loading
api.description: Communicates pending work and prevents duplicate activation.

api.name: hasActiveFilter
api.description: Distinguishes filtered empty from no data.

api.name: filteredEmptyMessage
api.defaultValue: No results match the current filter.
api.description: Consumer copy for a filtered empty collection.

api.name: loadingMore
api.description: Communicates incremental loading without implying virtualization.

api.name: endOfResults
api.description: Communicates the end of an incrementally loaded collection.

api.name: footer
api.description: Consumer-owned pagination, summary, or bulk-action region.

dataCollection.intent: Present comparable business records with normalized sort, selection, visibility, state, and responsive strategy.
useWhen: 50 or fewer visible fields/records need business table interaction
sort, selection, pagination, or row actions are consumer-owned but need a stable presentation contract
avoidWhen: one record's metadata fits a DescriptionList
100,000 interactive rows or spreadsheet-grade editing needs an approved engine adapter
dataCollection.rowCountSuitability: bounded and server-windowed business collections; do not imply virtualization from the component alone
consumerOwns: data source, query/filter/sort logic, page or cursor state, permissions, row actions, and detail routing
ten4sevenOwns: column and row semantics, selection exposure, state grammar, density, column priority metadata, and responsive intent
compatibility: DataTable does not fetch data and does not become an ARIA grid unless the interaction contract truly requires cell navigation.
